text:
```yaml
name: Maintenance – Agentic Workflow Category Check

on:
  push:
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/**
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/**

jobs:
  check-discussion-category:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Verify all create‑discussion actions use the Agentic Workflows category
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mismatch=0
          # Find all workflow files
          while IFS= read -r -d '' file; do
            # Search for discussion_category_name lines
            while IFS= read -r line; do
              if [[ $line =~ discussion_category_name: ]]; then
                # Extract the value (trim quotes and whitespace)
                value=$(echo "$line" | awk -F': ' '{print $2}' | tr -d '" ' | tr -d '\t')
                if [[ "$value" != "agentic-workflows" ]]; then
                  echo "❌ $file has discussion_category_name: $value (expected 'agentic-workflows')"
                  mismatch=1
                fi
              fi
            done < "$file"
          done < <(find .github/workflows -type f \( -name '*.yml' -o -name '*.yaml' \) -print0)

          if [[ "$mismatch" -ne 0 ]]; then
            echo "One or more workflows are not using the correct Agentic Workflows category."
            exit 1
          else
            echo "✅ All create‑discussion actions use the correct Agentic Workflows category."
          fi
```
